name: Training log standard
base: Local WTW scalar and media logging
integration_status: Specification only. Trainer adapters and W&B views require implementation.

naming.native_sdk_keys: Preserve native W&B system keys and internal keys.
naming.category_prefix: Store the category in configuration. Keep metric roots identical across categories.
naming.duplicates: Publish each quantity once. Preserve original detailed records as files.
naming.dynamic_names: Keep clip IDs, checkpoint IDs, and unbounded horizon values in tables or files.

workspace.tracking_panels: Use one representative error per concept. Give left and right measurements separate plots for comparisons across runs.
workspace.diagnostics: Retain detailed diagnostics in files. Add percentile, extrema, and alternate-frame plots only for a specific diagnosis.
workspace.plots: Keep units visible. Use step plots for discrete stages and event counts.
workspace.inactive_sections: Hide Curriculum without meaningful active curriculum measurements. Hide SM Media until actual policy recordings exist.
workspace.configuration_tables: Do not display placeholder or run-configuration tables. Preserve specifications in run configuration.
workspace.reward_components: Show all active signed episodic reward components through pagination.
workspace.sm_encoder_routes: Separate SMPL and robot route training outcomes, exposures, and completed episode populations. Do not claim matched evaluation from different training samples.

axes.Train/iter: Absolute trainer update counter. An update has a trainer-specific meaning.
axes.Train/steps: Absolute count of actual environment transitions across all workers.
axes.Train/time_s: Cumulative active training wall seconds, including logging and saves. Exclude downtime between processes.
axes.resume: Restore absolute counters and active elapsed time. Record parent identity and checkpoint counters.
axes.branch: Use a new linked run when restored counters overlap history. Preserve the original history.
axes.payload: Include the relevant axis values with every scalar payload.
axes.wandb: Declare custom axes with define_metric. Do not use upload-call counts as training progress.

reductions.scalar_window: Record the interval start, interval end, and sample counts in the metric registry or payload.
reductions.episodes: Pool completed episodes in the logging interval. Use the same episodes for returns, components, and episode lengths.
reductions.empty_episodes: Log Episode/count as zero. Omit episodic averages when no episodes complete.
reductions.tracking: Pool valid samples. Exclude reset discontinuities. Record terminal handling, frame, reference timing, and sampling policy.
reductions.statistics: Use the mean unless the key specifies p95, max, sum, or another registered statistic.
reductions.incompatible_statistics: Keep pooled statistics separate from averages of group summaries. Do not reuse one key for both.
reductions.percentiles: Calculate percentiles from pooled samples or a documented estimator. Do not average subgroup percentiles.
reductions.unavailable: Omit unavailable values. Record the reason in configuration. Do not substitute zero.
reductions.nonfinite: Record numerical failures explicitly in the detailed record. Do not silently convert nonfinite values to zero.

reward_contract.total: Mean undiscounted return across completed episodes. Use the actual applied reward, including terminal terms and final transformations.
reward_contract.step: Mean applied reward across actual transitions in the logging interval, including terminal transitions.
reward_contract.terms: Mean signed, weighted episodic contribution for each additive term. Use the same completed episodes as Reward/total.
reward_contract.raw: Optional unweighted term diagnostics. Declare the unit and reduction for each term.
reward_contract.rate: Reward per simulated second. Record the simulated-time denominator. Keep rates separate from episodic returns.
reward_contract.additivity: Require component sums to match the total only for additive rewards with identical populations and transformations.
reward_contract.nonlinear: Record nonlinear reward composition. Do not claim that raw factors sum to the applied reward.
reward_contract.legacy: Recompute incompatible reductions from source accumulators. Do not obtain the standard through renaming alone.

Loss/policy.definition: Actual policy objective. Record the sign, normalization, and reduction.

Loss/value.definition: Actual value objective. Record the normalization and reduction.

Train/ppo/entropy.definition: Policy entropy statistic. Record action reduction and estimator.

Train/grad/policy.definition: Preclip norm. Record the norm definition.

Train/grad/value.definition: Preclip norm. Record the norm definition.

Metrics/body/palm_l_m.definition: Left palm TCP error in each pose's own hip frame.

Metrics/body/palm_r_m.definition: Right palm TCP error in each pose's own hip frame.

Metrics/world/palm_l_m.definition: Left palm TCP error in the original world frame.

Metrics/world/palm_r_m.definition: Right palm TCP error in the original world frame.

Metrics/vel/xy_mps.definition: Mean planar command error norm. Record the frame and reference.

Metrics/vel/yaw_radps.definition: Mean absolute yaw-rate command error. Record the frame.

Curriculum/stage.definition: Record the ordered stage definitions in configuration.

Curriculum/horizon.definition: Active horizon. Record whether steps represent control or model steps.

Curriculum/event/promote.definition: Count promotions in the logging interval. Preserve exact events in the event table.

Curriculum/event/demote.definition: Count demotions in the logging interval. Preserve exact events in the event table.

Curriculum/block/any.definition: Any active promotion blocker. The final stage alone is not a blocker.

Episode/len_s.definition: Use the actual control period for each completed episode.

Episode/fail_frac.definition: Failed completed episodes divided by completed episodes.

Episode/timeout_frac.definition: Timed-out completed episodes divided by completed episodes.

Perf/fps.definition: Actual transition delta divided by wall seconds. Include logging, rendering, and checkpoint overhead.

Perf/collect_fps.definition: Actual transition delta divided by measured collection seconds for the same complete interval.

Perf/time/collect_s.definition: Host collection time divided by the number of timed updates.

Perf/time/learn_s.definition: Host time for all learning phases per update. Include model learning where applicable.

Perf/time/iter_s.definition: Full wall seconds per update, including logging and saves.

Perf/time/policy_s.definition: Record whether the phase includes value learning.

Media/video.definition: Rollout video linked to capture counters and checkpoint identity.

Media/viser.definition: Durable Viser review reference with synchronized human input when applicable.

Media/status.definition: Capture identity, counters, upload state, and unavailable reasons.

Curriculum/gates.definition: Detailed gates for each route, horizon, statistic, threshold, and validation counter.

Curriculum/events.definition: Exact event counter, time, previous stage, new stage, horizon, reason, and manual flag.

Env/adp_samp/prob_mean.definition: Mean adaptive sampling probability over the registered population.

templates.definition: Weighted additive episodic contribution under the reward contract.

configuration.purpose: Store fixed specifications once. Plot changing values as metrics.
configuration.unknown: Record unavailable specifications explicitly. Do not guess.
configuration.resources: Measure the training worker. A publisher host must not masquerade as the training system.

registry.not_applicable: Use an explicit not_applicable field value where a definition does not apply.
registry.short_names: Store detailed meanings here so plot names remain short.
registry.comparisons: Compare metrics only when their definitions, populations, and reductions match.
registry.extensions: Register category-specific keys under existing sections. Preserve the shared key definitions.

sm.algorithm: Record the actual algorithm. Select PPO or world-model fields accordingly.

media.base: Retain WTW video, synchronized debug signals, debug images, and event markers.
media.cadence: Use supported native frame cadence. Record category overrides. Deduplicate overlapping triggers.
media.timing: Preserve signal timestamps and video-frame timestamps. Mark resets, pushes, failures, and curriculum changes.
media.identity: Record capture iteration, transition counters, checkpoint, environment, motion or command, camera, and probe seed.
media.asynchronous: Preserve capture counters in metadata. Do not label an old video with the current checkpoint.
media.files: Retain MP4, debug JSON, and metadata as associated files. Upload video and debug images together.
media.probe: Use a separate evaluation environment for fixed probes. Preserve training RNG and the training environment distribution.
media.motion: Provide synchronized Viser comparison with the original SMPL or SMPL-X input when human motion exists.
media.appearance: Preserve original robot materials and default MuJoCo visual settings.
media.availability: Record unavailable media and the reason. Scalar logging must continue.

publication.smoke: Write local logs and evidence only. Do not initialize or publish W&B telemetry.
publication.full: Initialize the full W&B run before training. Verify received metrics before training.
publication.curriculum: Verify the dedicated Curriculum section before full curriculum training.
publication.continuity: Maintain live telemetry until training ends. Preserve history and explicit gaps.
publication.links: Provide the full W&B run link and the associated PR link.
publication.stop_condition: Preserve the authorized stopping criterion. The logging format does not impose a training limit.

migration.policy: Apply adapters to future runs. Preserve existing histories and detailed source files.

sm.action: Preserve the normalization. Do not use this value as episodic return.
Confirm the applied reward boundary and pooled transition reduction.
Preserve sampling and pooling. Recompute if the source averages group summaries.
Preserve the hip frame, palm offset, sample policy, and pooled reduction.
